messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — audit export currently gives "actor_id" and a top-level change blob, but we don't have per-field attribution nor a way to capture the operator-provided reason. Compliance wants to tie each routing/policy change to a human-readable rationale and the canary/rollout context.
Raj: +1. We get downstream tickets that say 'who changed the route' but can't tell why. Need: field-level before/after + optional "reason" + rollout_id link.
Sylvie: For UI it would be great to show a compact diff viewer and a pill for "change reason". If reason is blank, show "not provided" and surface an annotation that the change came from a service-account vs user.
Nate: Technical constraints — the change event emitter currently serializes the whole config object. To do field-level diffs we'd either emit a patch list (JSON Patch) or store pre/post and compute the diff in the downstream exporter. Which do we prefer?
Olivia: Prefer the emitter to include a small patch list. Easier for consumers and less coupling. Example payload sketch: ```
actor: { "id": "u_123", "email": "olivia@redwood.ai", "type": "user" }
change: [ { "op": "replace", "path": "/routing/policies/0/priority", "from": "50", "to": "100" }, ... ]
meta: { "rollout_id": "r-2026-03-19-87", "reason": "alignment with new SLAs", "trace_id": "t-abc-123" }
```
Raj: +1 for JSON Patch list. Also add "actor_agent" to capture origin (console-v2, terraform-provider, api) — helps downstream grouping.
Compliance: Export needs two guarantees: 1) immutable snapshot (signed manifest + checksum) and 2) retention labeling (legal_hold tag). Also actor.identity must include org role at time-of-change for audits.
Sylvie: UI filters requested: filter by actor.email, actor.type (service_account/human), rollout_id, timeframe, and change path (prefix match). Also quick search for "reason:contains(...)".
deploy-bot: new audit export job queued 1835001260
Nate: Implementation plan: event-emitter -> append-only event-store -> export worker produces ndjson stream + gz/zstd + manifest.json with checksums signed by internal key. Export API: /v1/audit_exports?since=...&filters=... returns signed URL.
Olivia: UX: when someone edits via console prompt for "reason" with optional dropdown + free text. Make reason required for high-risk paths (routing policy changes, quota updates).
Raj: We should also capture delta origin explicitly via "actor_agent". actor.type is good, but agent string is useful for automation.
Sylvie: Diff viewer mock: show pre/post line highlights, collapse large unchanged blocks, and add a "reconstruct state at t" link that uses snapshot_id (helpful for oncall).
Compliance: Retention policy mapping: default 1yr, enterprise overrides, legal_hold infinite. Exports must include retention metadata and snapshot_id.
Olivia: Security note — don't leak secrets in change blobs. Need a sanitizer step that strips/masks secret fields before export. Add a warning field in manifest if masking occurred.
Nate: Prototype diff emission + manifest signing next sprint. ETA: PR by 1835600000 for event format and small console change for reason prompt.
Raj: Follow-up — how large can patch lists get? For big policy trees it's expensive. Consider switching to pre/post snapshot reference when ops > 200.
Olivia: Agree: if patch_ops > 200 -> store pre/post snapshot reference instead of inline patch; include snapshot_id in change.meta.
deploy-bot: audit-emitter service v1.12 deployed to staging at 1835001287 :rocket:
Sylvie: I'll start mockups for diff viewer and reason prompt, add acceptance criteria to the ticket.
Compliance: cc @Legal — flag for retention override approval flow.
Olivia: Thanks all — I'll file a spec doc in design and link the PR once ready. :thumbsup:
